items.en_title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI is buying Pierre Computer Company to give Codex stronger tooling for writing, reading, and reviewing code.

items.title: v1.107.10 (2026-11-04)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 1.107.10 backports the same high-severity web fetch security fix to the 1.x line.

items.title: v2.66.0 (2026-11-04)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.66.0 fixes a high-severity security issue where the web fetch tool's local fallback reshaped JSON before checking its content.

items.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
items.en_title: A thousand fewer paths to root
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's autonomous pipeline tracked down, verified, and patched 948 local privilege-escalation flaws in the Linux kernel.

items.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.en_title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.en_oneliner: Through Amazon Bedrock, Daybreak Red delivers GPT-5.6 Cyber to authorized customers in GovCloud for compliant cybersecurity work.
Claude Code 2.1.318 now records your answer when it asks to switch on mods written in a session, and adds assume-role support on the gateway's mantle upstreams.

items.title: Introducing Images 2.6
items.en_oneliner: The new version generates images faster, adds GIF creation and sharper editing, and brings fresh controls to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

items.title: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
items.en_title: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
items.en_oneliner: DevRev runs Computer and Operator on GPT-6.1 Sol, striking a balance between reasoning, speed, and cost for its enterprise customers.

items.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
items.en_oneliner: Google Antigravity and cheminformatics skills accelerate drug discovery workflows, searching compounds and proposing novel rigidified macrocycles.

items.title: Agents SDK v0.24.0-alpha.6
items.en_oneliner: This Agents SDK preview ships a native runtime installable with plain CPython 3.10 to 3.14 in a virtual environment, with no Rust toolchain or source build needed.

items.title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
items.en_title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
items.en_oneliner: Palette teaches a small model to build decks in your design language, so small teams can produce consistently styled presentations at low cost.
